overview_description.description:
PolicyBazaar designs an online life insurance and general insurance comparison portal that analyzes financial products. Its insurance comparison portal and mobile application provide information across products such as medical, term life, travel or motor insurance, low prices ULIPS, and other investment products, enabling consumers to compare and analyze financial products.

Users can compare different insurance plans based on parameters such as coverage, premium, benefits, and exclusions. The platform provides information about various insurance products and helps users make informed decisions about their insurance needs. Policybazaar also offers tools and calculators to help users estimate their insurance requirements and premiums.

about_short_description.short_description: Policybazaar is an insurance broker that offers a platform to compare and buy insurance policies from various insurance providers.

product.name: Insurance Comparison and Purchase Platform
product.description: An online insurance marketplace for comparing premiums, coverage, benefits, and policy terms from multiple insurers, then purchasing policies digitally.

product.name: Term Life Insurance
product.description: A comparison and purchase service for term life insurance plans that provide financial protection to a policyholder’s dependants during the policy term.

product.name: Health Insurance
product.description: A comparison and purchase service for individual, family, senior-citizen, maternity, critical-illness, and other health insurance plans.

product.name: Motor Insurance
product.description: A digital comparison and purchase service for car, two-wheeler, and commercial vehicle insurance, including third-party, comprehensive, electric-vehicle, and add-on coverage.

product.name: Investment and Savings Plans
product.description: A marketplace for insurance-linked and retirement-oriented investment products, including ULIPs, guaranteed-return, endowment, child, pension, annuity, and money-back plans.

product.name: Travel Insurance
product.description: A service for comparing and purchasing domestic and international travel insurance, including destination-specific and Schengen plans.
